# Rapar Rubel (Rubel Miah)

> Rapar Rubel is the online name of Rubel Miah, also known as Rubel Public: a business builder and AI & product operator based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He works across business strategy, AI workflows and automation, digital products, branding, content and venture operations, and builds AI that works in Bangla, Banglish and English.

## Identity
- Real name: Rubel Miah
- Online / creative name: Rapar Rubel
- Other public identity: Rubel Public
- Based in: Dhaka, Bangladesh (GMT+6)
- Role: Business Builder, AI & Product Operator, Independent Business Architect

## Services
- Business strategy: business models, pricing, offers, funnels, operating plans
- AI: agents, prompt systems, workflow automation, team training in Bangla and English
- Product: websites, web apps and internal tools from brief to launch
- Creative: brand systems, campaigns, social creative, AI video direction
- Operations: hands-on coordination across technology, retail, property and marketing

## Work
- MimAI: AI file assistant for the user's own Google Drive; understands Bangla, Banglish and English (https://mimai.onrender.com)
- Proyojon Abashon: land share and property management platform in Dhaka (https://www.proyojonabashon.com)
- Proyojon Prozukti: technology, digital marketing, creative and business-solutions brand
- Proyojon Solutions: online-first legal and business advisory with AI-assisted intake
- Proyojon Shop / Proyojon 360: retail and import of toys, stationery, bags and accessories
- The AB Wardrobe: women's kurti and two-piece label
- Proyojon Vromon: travel brand for Bangla-reading travellers
- Gaan Banai — MusicDirector: creative-AI music workflow concept
- AI Power User: practical AI course taught in Bangla (10 classes, 18–20 hours, 70% hands-on)
